d: The BJP-led NDA wins 16 of the 28 MLC seats across Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar and Karnataka, while the Congress manages just one win in Nagpur. The setback in Karnataka, where the Congress is in power but fails to win a single seat, raises questions about whether the Opposition’s campaign against alleged ‘vote chori’ and the Special Intensive Revision is translating into electoral gains. The Hindu’s Associate Editor Sandeep Phukan analyses the results and the challenges facing the Congress.
